title: Real Provider Study Statistical Design and Estimands Specification for E11 (Two-Model Utility Replication) and E12 (Malformed Output Sensitivity)

global_parameters.hypothesis_testing_framework: Schuirmann Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) & Exact Paired Sign Test
global_parameters.power_analysis_summary: 94.1% power at N=384 paired subjects for equivalence margin delta = +/- 0.02 at alpha = 0.05 (exact non-central t integration with true mean difference d_bar = 0.0 and sigma_d = 0.111; >99.8% power if sigma_d <= 0.08)
global_parameters.fail_closed_policy: If commercial provider API credentials or network connectivity are missing, evaluation is marked NOT_RUN; zero synthetic mocking permitted.

E11.title: Two-Model Clinical Utility & Governance Equivalence
primary_research_questions: Does task-minimized governed context projection (THSS snapshot bound) maintain clinical utility equivalent to full unbounded authorized history across distinct production model architectures?
Is the paired clinical accuracy difference strictly bounded within [-0.02, +0.02] under Schuirmann TOST at alpha=0.05?
What is the token consumption reduction and inference latency savings achieved by governed disclosure projection?

tost_mathematical_formulation.null_hypothesis_H0: |Theta_A - Theta_B| >= delta (Utility difference equals or exceeds equivalence margin delta = 0.02)
tost_mathematical_formulation.decision_rule: Reject H0 in favor of H1 if p_TOST < alpha (0.05); equivalent to 90% CI for (Theta_A - Theta_B) lying strictly inside (-0.02, +0.02).

primary.name: Paired Clinical Accuracy Difference (Theta_A - Theta_B)
primary.definition: Mean paired difference in clinical decision correctness score between governed context (Arm A) and full authorized context (Arm B).
primary.aggregation: Mean paired difference with 95% BCa bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples) and Schuirmann TOST p-value.
primary.target: TOST rejection of H0 with p_TOST < 0.05 and 95% BCa CI inside [-0.02, +0.02].

secondary.name: Exact Paired Sign Test P-Value
secondary.definition: Exact non-parametric sign test on discordant paired subject outcomes (Score_A,i != Score_B,i).
secondary.formula: P(X >= k) under Binomial(N_discordant, 0.5) where k = max(n_pos, n_neg)
secondary.target: p > 0.05 (no directional bias between context conditions).

secondary.name: Token Overhead Ratio (Governed / Unbounded)
secondary.definition: Ratio of total prompt tokens consumed under governed context projection to full authorized profile context.
secondary.aggregation: Mean and 95% bootstrap CI across N=384 subjects.

secondary.name: Inference Latency Delta (ms)
secondary.definition: Difference in provider completion response latency between governed projection and unbounded context.
secondary.aggregation: Median (p50) and p95 latency difference with bootstrap CIs.

power_analysis.notes: Exact integration yields 94.1% power at sigma_d = 0.111; if empirical sigma_d <= 0.08, power exceeds 99.8%.
power_analysis.calculation_method: Exact Owen / Phillips non-central t distribution integration for TOST power

fail_closed_criteria: If provider API returns HTTP 401/403 or invalid credentials, benchmark halts and reports NOT_RUN.
Any response missing immutable execution metadata (request_id, reported_model, token counts) fails invariant I12.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Provider API rate limits or transient errors are re-attempted under R2 retry; unresolvable failures pass to E12 sensitivity analysis.

E12.title: Malformed Output Sensitivity & Multi-Regime Repair Analysis Protocol
primary_research_questions: What is the baseline Intention-To-Treat (ITT) R0 malformed output rate across commercial model provider executions?
How effectively do deterministic local JSON repair (R1), single-retry recovery (R2), and constrained schema fallback (R3) mitigate structured parsing failures?
Does malformed output sensitivity stratify significantly across model provider, context condition, clinical task family, or attempt iteration?

sample_size_allocation.source: Full E11 response completion ledger (384 paired subject cases x 2 context arms)

R0.name: Intention-To-Treat (ITT) Baseline Primary Arm
R0.description: Raw un-repaired model output evaluated directly against JSON schema and clinical proposal parser. Zero recovery applied.

R1.name: Deterministic Local JSON / Syntax Repair
R1.description: Single-pass local syntactic repair (stripping markdown codeblocks, fixing unescaped quotes, closing dangling brackets/braces, removing trailing commas).

R2.name: Single-Retry Prompting Recovery
R2.description: Automatic re-execution of the query with error diagnostics feedback injected into system prompt on R1 failure.

R3.name: Constrained Schema Repair & Fail-Closed Escalation
R3.description: Constrained decoding grammar parser fallback; if parsing remains invalid, transaction strictly fails closed with deterministic error reason code.

error_taxonomy_classes.description: Malformed JSON syntax (unclosed strings, bad tokens, syntax errors).
Valid JSON but missing required fields or incorrect property types.
Completion cut off at token length limit prior to JSON closure.
Model safety or policy refusal to generate clinical recommendation.
Zero bytes or whitespace-only response body returned by provider.
HTTP 5xx server error or upstream provider API failure.
Provider returned completion from model ID differing from requested.
Request exceeded gateway socket timeout setting.
Output contained forbidden HTML, markdown noise, or invalid preamble.
Valid schema but violates clinical semantic constraints or domain assertions.
HTTP 429 rate limit error code from provider endpoint.
Any unexpected or uncategorized provider execution failure.

primary.name: Intention-To-Treat (ITT) R0 Malformed Rate
primary.definition: Proportion of raw initial model completions exhibiting any error taxonomy violation.
primary.aggregation: Sample proportion with 95% Wilson score confidence interval.
primary.target: <= 0.05 (5.0% maximum acceptable ITT baseline failure rate).

secondary.name: R1 Local Repair Recovery Rate
secondary.definition: Proportion of R0 malformed completions successfully resolved by R1 deterministic local repair.

secondary.name: R2 Single-Retry Recovery Rate
secondary.definition: Proportion of R1 unrecovered failures resolved by single retry prompt re-execution.

secondary.name: R3 Constrained Escalation / Fail-Closed Rate
secondary.definition: Proportion of unrecovered failures safely escalating to fail-closed state rejection without state corruption.
secondary.aggregation: Proportion with 1-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB on safety violations.

fail_closed_criteria: Any unclassified error failing to produce a deterministic fail-closed code halts evaluation.
Any state corruption resulting from malformed output parsing fails invariant I10 and invalidates run.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Missing model responses count directly as ITT R0 failures; no unobserved data imputation permitted.

reproducibility_and_sealing.checksum_rule: Raw provider ledgers, derived TOST statistical outputs, BCa bootstrap iterations, and Markdown report summaries must be registered in checksums.sha256 and seal.json.
